product_summary: An iced matcha milk latte in a tall clear tumbler: natural deep green matcha in the upper half, pale milk below, irregular clear ice and fine surface bubbles. This Wood Handheld preset preserves the complete user cup and must show a credible visible sidewall in the lower hand.

container.class: tall clear tumbler in the source image; preserve the complete source cup in this preset
container.material: clear transparent glass or plastic from the source
container.geometry: source vessel is tall and gently tapered; preserve its rim, wall, base and sidewall under the new high-oblique window camera

branding.placement: no intentional branding or readable text should be added

must_preserve: deep natural matcha green concentrated toward the upper layer
pale milky lower layer with soft irregular green diffusion
multiple irregular clear ice cubes and small surface bubbles
complete source cup sidewall, rim and base in preserve-source mode
visible side layers under one neutral wood-window exposure
no invented logo, text, fruit, cream scoop, garnish or straw

evidence: clear ice is visible across the upper beverage
green matcha and pale milk form a soft vertical color relationship
small bubbles and translucent highlights are visible around the ice

visual_anchor.feature: natural matcha-green upper layer, pale milky lower layer, irregular clear ice and fine bubbles under warm cafe light
visual_anchor.emphasis_method: preserve the relative green-to-milk gradient, ice translucency and small bubbles while matching the reference scene exposure, diffuse light and contact shadow

issues: source is a vertical close crop with a tall vessel and a large neutral tabletop field
source light is warmer and more frontal than the approved white close-up scene
evidence: ice, milk and matcha layers remain readable
the glass wall and lower contact area are visible

presentation_correction.intent: reconstruct the exact attached iced matcha milk beverage and complete source tumbler in the lower-centre Wood Handheld two-person scene, held by the 6 o'clock hand with sidewall layers visible

preferred_capture.rotation: follow the dedicated iced pose hint: rim center left of base center, never an eye-level cup rotated in 2D

allowed: re-light beverage optics under target window light
preserve source cup geometry and visible sidewall
adjust scale only within target held-slot corridor
forbidden: replace source cup with a ceramic hot cup
flatten to a top-only cup view
invent straw, logo, fruit, cream or garnish
retain source background, source hand or source shadow
